newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Disco SA upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Disco SA upgraded.

text.p: -- Smith Barney said it upgraded Disco SA to outperform from neutral.
-- raised the 12-month price target to $38 per ADR from $30 per ADR.
-- raised the 1997 earnings estimate to $1.55 per ADR from $1.50 per ADR and increased the 1998 earnings estimate to $1.90 per ADR from $1.80.
-- said Disco's solid fundamentals will be helped by stronger than expected economic expansion underway in Argentina.
-- said believes stock will perform well in the short-term due to stronger than expected earnings in the fourth quarter.
